content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler peas, Stage 2 are gently cooked, lightly mashed pea purees designed for children aged 8 to 12 months. The puree is made from selected green peas, without added sugar, salt, or artificial flavors. Its texture supports the development of self‑feeding skills.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Peas are one of the first vegetables introduced to infants because of their mild flavor and soft texture.
Stage 2 puree contains small soft pieces to help develop chewing abilities.
Peas are a good source of plant protein, supporting growth and tissue development.
Only whole peas are used, with no added starches or thickeners.
Pea purees are often combined with other vegetables, but this version keeps the pure pea taste.

items.title: Rich in plant protein
items.content: Peas provide high‑quality protein essential for muscle and organ growth.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber supports healthy digestion and regular bowel movements.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Peas contain folate, thiamine, and vitamin B6, important for nervous system function and metabolism.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: They supply iron, magnesium, and phosphorus, which aid bone development and blood formation.

items.title: Low sodium
items.content: No added salt makes the product safe for infants' kidneys.

items.title: Legume allergy
items.content: Some children may be allergic to peas; introduce the product under supervision.

items.title: Choking hazard
items.content: Although Stage 2 contains small soft pieces, they should be offered only with adult supervision.

items.title: Phytic acid content
items.content: Phytic acid can reduce mineral absorption; a varied diet helps mitigate this.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the puree warm (not hot) in a baby bowl. For a thinner consistency, add a little breast milk, formula, or vegetable broth. It can be mixed with soft pieces of potato or carrot for extra flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the unopened package in a cool, dry place. Once opened, store in the refrigerator and use within 3 days. Unused portions can be frozen in an airtight container for up to 1 month. Reheat thoroughly and stir before serving.
